title: Kerala Legislative Assembly 2026 (holdout)

LDF.note: 2021 LDF intact per frozen rev 2026-03-12 (CPM, CPI, KC(M), JD(S)-successor ISJD, NCP(SP), RJD, INL, minor KCs); all stayed -> weight 1 vs AE2021

UDF.note: 2021 UDF intact (INC, IUML, KC-Joseph=KEC, RSP, KC-Jacob) plus new micro-entrants (KDP, RMP, CMP, AIFB, TMC-Kerala) with negligible 2021 base

NDA.note: BJP+BDJS as 2021; Twenty20 Kizhakkambalam joined NDA (contested alone 2021, 0.71 -> tau); AIADMK-KL negligible

poll_corrections.rule: no KL vote-share poll history in the N=46 ledger (2016/2021 polls were seat projections only) -> corrections 0

quality_flags: ONE pre-freeze poll only (IANS-Matrize 15 Mar, unrated, n=12,015; midpoints of 42-43/41-42/12-13 ranges). M3 rests on a single unrated poll at sigma 6.0.

Freeze set to 2026-03-16 (T-24d, just after the EC schedule announcement of 15 Mar) instead of strict T-28d (2026-03-12): the 12 Mar frozen revision has EMPTY poll tables and the only published pre-campaign poll is dated 15 Mar. Decision made before seeing any result. At strict T-28 this forecast would be poll-less.

Poll record read from the last pre-election frozen revision (2026-04-08) because the 16 Mar revision's tables were still empty; only the poll PUBLISHED on/before freeze was admitted. Post-freeze polls (incl. rated CVoter 31 Mar) were visible in that revision but excluded.
History note: Kerala has alternated LDF/UDF every election since 1982 except 2021; LDF seeks a third consecutive term.

tripwires.effect: M3 upgrades to rated sigma (CVoter did publish 31 Mar - post-freeze, excluded)
